title: RCMP's handling of Alberta woman who died in cell under review
subtitle: Charlene Danais wasn't breathing when she was found Sunday in a cell in Assumption, a community 900 kilometres northwest of Edmonton
article: The Commission for Public Complaints Against the RCMP is looking into the actions of officers following the death of a woman in custody in a northern Alberta detachment.
Charlene Danais wasn't breathing when she was found Sunday in a cell in Assumption, a community 900 kilometres northwest of Edmonton
The 28-year-old was later pronounced dead at the hospital in High Level.
An autopsy could not determine the cause of death. Toxicology results are not expected for several months.
The commission will examine whether Mounties followed policies and procedures during the woman's arrest and during the time she spent in custody.
